1.title: Real-time Auction Platform
1.desc: A high-performance real-time online auction system. Handles continuous live bidding, millisecond-precision countdowns, and instant broadcast of auction results using Spring Boot, Redis Pub/Sub, and WebSockets.

2.title: RideBook
2.desc: Backend architecture for an online ride-booking platform. Engineered to support real-time GPS tracking, smart driver-passenger matching algorithms via Redis Geo, and secure transaction workflows.

3.title: E-Commerce Microservices
3.desc: An e-commerce platform built on a scalable microservices architecture. Encompasses secure JWT authentication, dynamic product catalogs, and asynchronous order management.

4.title: English Learning App
4.desc: Cross-platform English learning application built on a gamification model. Features real-time progress tracking, a virtual shop system, and AI-assisted learning APIs.
